title: Maine and the Canada tariff waiver

scenes.narration: [excited] Eleven days before the vote, Maine got a break on Canada tariffs.
scenes.imagePrompt: a quiet border crossing in the Maine woods at sunrise, a lone truck on the road

scenes.narration: The fifty percent tariffs had hit about twenty billion dollars of Canadian goods.
scenes.imagePrompt: stacks of lumber and wooden crates of blueberries in a warm-lit warehouse

scenes.narration: Senator Collins took credit for the waiver. Troy Jackson said it was too little, too late.
scenes.imagePrompt: a Maine harbor at dawn with lobster boats and golden light on the water

scenes.narration: Jackson won, about fifty-four to forty-six, ending nearly thirty years in the seat.
scenes.imagePrompt: a logging road through tall pines in Aroostook County with sun rays
